title: check.py validates the kb path:line citations in _tools comments, so a fact inserted above them cannot shift them silently
goal: A kb article citation <path>:<line> in a _tools/*.py comment points at a fact line that still holds what the citation needs (at least the model or term named beside it), and check.py or a test reports one that does not; in SP-7y6dk257 one new fact at ci-and-headless.md:87 shifted five PRICE citations in bench_core.py and nothing reported it. Retrospective of SP-7y6dk257.
notes: Premise: run at planning (SP-5i4itd2d): check.py reads no _tools comment (its citation rules cover _answers.md and _gaps.md only) and tests.py -k code_kb_citations collects no test: reproduces; bench_core.py holds 10 kb path:line citations in comments. The -k selector names the test this item adds: it collects none until then and exits 2, which is its failing state. Order: after ST-vlkxprhy (same check.py).
